name: Effects Studio
description: Adds creator-style finishing effects to a finished or filmed video: words behind the speaker, spotlight, checklists, glass graphs, headline boxes, stamps, punch-ins and grades. The AI watches the video (face on screen, what is said and when) and picks and times the effects.

edit.explainer_effects.reason: needs the video to add effects to

best_for: talking-head videos (effects track the face and sit behind the person)
engaging text pops, checklists and graphs timed to speech
profile_notes: Added 2026-11-13. 24 of the tool's 51 effects are offered (the ones that take their text from the plan and need no folder of the user's posts). Face-tracked effects only when a face is detected. Keeps the original audio; adds no captions or sounds. Renders at 1080p locally.
